delta.comment: Stage fix cycle 2 (2026-08-19, P1 coherence). Feature restatement item 3 required the deferred ID to be referenced in the review-thread reply unconditionally, matching the stale authoritative C3 in 134.001-T. Updated to the conditional disposition: reply citation where a thread actually exists (satisfying P-018 honestly), and task/run/closure residual-risk citation in every case including threadless build/CI and pre-PR local-review findings where no reply is possible. No other feature scope changed.

Contract replanning (operator-directed, 2026-08-19): DoD updated for the new semantic contract test (134.012-T) and the exhaustive carrier matrix; goal 6 extended with Stage-owned late-identifier reconciliation; H13 staged-change inventory extended with references/azd-backlogbuilder and references/azd-backlogloader, noting the enumerated allowlist (not inventory completeness) is what provides containment. Feature now spans 12 tasks.

Readiness fix cycle 1 (review of 1dad725a): coherence corrections. Goal 3's C3 citation summary previously said the deferred ID is referenced in the task/run/closure residual-risk record "in every case", conflating the two surfaces - thread-present discharges via the PR/closure record, threadless via task/run/closure. Now states the record SET differs by surface while a deferred ID is referenced in every case. Scope summary updated from "a new contract test" to two contract tests (structural coverage + semantic regression).
